items.q: Look at those dark clouds over the school gate! It ______ very soon.
items.vi: Nhìn mấy đám mây đen trên cổng trường kìa! Trời sắp mưa rồi.
items.explanation: A prediction based on present evidence (the dark clouds) takes be going to; the present simple, present perfect and past simple do not talk about the near future.

items.q: Nam paid the taxi ______ with the coins he had left in his pocket.
items.vi: Nam trả tiền taxi bằng mấy đồng xu còn lại trong túi.
items.explanation: The money you pay for a journey by taxi, bus or train is a fare; a fee is paid for a service such as a course, a fine is a punishment, and a tip is extra money given as thanks.

items.q: There was ______ rain all afternoon, so the football match was cancelled.
items.vi: Mưa to suốt cả buổi chiều nên trận bóng đá đã bị hủy.
items.explanation: Rain that falls in large amounts is heavy rain; strong goes with wind, and hard and big do not collocate with rain.

items.q: Lan: Did you buy the new maths workbook? / Nam: Yes, but I had to ______ for it at the shop near school.
items.vi: Lan: Cậu mua cuốn bài tập toán mới chưa? / Nam: Rồi, nhưng tớ phải trả giá cắt cổ ở tiệm gần trường.
items.explanation: To pay through the nose for something is to pay far too much for it. Pay lip service to means to support something only in words, pay your way is to pay your own costs, and pay your respects is to greet someone politely.

items.q: Lan: Who ______ your little brother when your parents are at work? / Nam: My grandmother does.
items.vi: Lan: Ai trông em trai cậu khi bố mẹ cậu đi làm? / Nam: Bà tớ.
items.explanation: Look after means to take care of someone. Look up is to find information, look into is to investigate, and look for is to search for something lost.

items.q: Nam ______ have taken my umbrella — he wasn't even at school today.
items.vi: Nam không thể nào lấy ô của tớ được — hôm nay cậu ấy thậm chí còn không đi học.
items.explanation: Can't have + past participle says that something was impossible in the past; must have would mean the speaker is sure it happened, which the second clause rules out.

items.q: The teacher ______ class we have on Monday mornings is going to retire next year.
items.vi: Cô giáo mà chúng tôi có tiết học vào các sáng thứ Hai sẽ nghỉ hưu vào năm sau.
items.explanation: A noun (class) follows the blank, so the relative pronoun must show possession: whose. Who, which and whom cannot be followed directly by a noun in this way.

items.q: Lan: Do you want to play badminton? / Nam: Sorry, I have too ______ homework to finish before nine.
items.vi: Lan: Cậu có muốn chơi cầu lông không? / Nam: Xin lỗi, tớ có quá nhiều bài tập về nhà phải làm xong trước chín giờ.
items.explanation: Homework is an uncountable noun, so it takes too much; many and few go with countable nouns, and a lot cannot follow too.

items.q: Remember ______ your project to school tomorrow — the teacher is going to collect it.
items.vi: Nhớ mang dự án đến trường ngày mai nhé — cô giáo sẽ thu đấy.
items.explanation: Remember to do something means not to forget a task you still have to do; remember doing refers to a memory of something already done.

items.q: It rained all day on Saturday; ______, the school picnic was put off until next week.
items.vi: Thứ Bảy trời mưa cả ngày; do đó, buổi dã ngoại của trường bị hoãn sang tuần sau.
items.explanation: The second sentence is the result of the first, so the linker is consequently; however and whereas show contrast and otherwise means 'if not'.

items.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will have PE in the gym instead of on the field.
items.vi: Nếu ngày mai trời mưa, chúng tôi sẽ học thể dục trong nhà thi đấu thay vì ngoài sân.
items.explanation: A real future possibility is a first conditional: if + present simple, will + verb in the main clause. Will does not go in the if-clause, and rained/would rain belong to the second conditional.

items.q: The final exam results ______ on the school website next Friday.
items.vi: Kết quả kỳ thi cuối kỳ sẽ được công bố trên trang web của trường vào thứ Sáu tới.
items.explanation: The results do not announce anything; they are announced by the school, so the verb must be passive: will be announced.

items.q: Lan said that she ______ a doctor when she grew up.
items.vi: Lan nói rằng khi lớn lên cô ấy sẽ trở thành bác sĩ.
items.explanation: After a past reporting verb (said), will shifts back to would; the present forms do not match the past tense of the whole sentence.

items.q: Our maths teacher is strict, but she is always patient ______ slow learners.
items.vi: Cô giáo toán của chúng tôi nghiêm khắc, nhưng cô luôn kiên nhẫn với những học sinh tiếp thu chậm.
items.explanation: The adjective patient takes the preposition with when it refers to a person; good at, kind to and famous for use other prepositions.

items.q: This winter is much ______ than last winter — I have to wear two jumpers to school.
items.vi: Mùa đông năm nay lạnh hơn nhiều so với mùa đông năm ngoái — tôi phải mặc hai cái áo len đi học.
items.explanation: Than signals a comparison of two things, so a comparative is needed: colder. A superlative is used with the and no than.

items.q: Whenever I show my brother an essay, he ______ it and tells me everything that is wrong.
items.vi: Mỗi lần tôi đưa anh trai xem bài luận, anh ấy lại bới lông tìm vết và chỉ ra mọi lỗi sai.
items.explanation: To pick holes in something is to find faults in it. Turn a blind eye to means to ignore, make light of is to treat as unimportant, and pull strings for is to use influence to help someone.

items.q: Lan: Do you ______ your new classmates? / Nam: Yes, they are really friendly.
items.vi: Lan: Cậu có hòa hợp với các bạn cùng lớp mới không? / Nam: Có, các bạn ấy rất thân thiện.
items.explanation: Get on with someone means to have a friendly relationship with them. Get over is to recover from something, get away with is to escape punishment, and get through is to finish or survive something.

items.q: I ______ my old primary school report while I was tidying my desk last night.
items.vi: Tối qua tôi tình cờ thấy học bạ tiểu học cũ của mình khi đang dọn bàn học.
items.explanation: A short action that happened during a longer one (while I was tidying) takes the past simple: came across. The past continuous is for the longer background action, and last night rules out the present perfect.

items.q: Please check the new class ______ — chemistry has moved to Thursday afternoon.
items.vi: Hãy kiểm tra thời khóa biểu mới của lớp — môn hóa đã chuyển sang chiều thứ Năm.
items.explanation: A list of the times of school lessons is a timetable; a calendar shows the days of the year, a diary is a personal record, and a menu lists food.

items.q: Keep the ______ in case the calculator stops working and you need to take it back to the shop.
items.vi: Hãy giữ hóa đơn phòng khi máy tính bỏ túi bị hỏng và bạn cần mang ra trả lại cửa hàng.
items.explanation: A receipt is the paper proving you paid for something, which a shop asks for when you return goods; a recipe is cooking instructions, a bill asks for payment, and a ticket lets you travel or enter.

items.q: The weather ______ says it will be sunny and 32 degrees in Ho Chi Minh City tomorrow.
items.vi: Dự báo thời tiết nói ngày mai ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh trời nắng và 32 độ.
items.explanation: A statement of what the weather will probably be is a weather forecast; estimate and guess are rough judgements, and prediction is not the word used with weather.

items.q: To get a part-time job at the café, you have to fill in an ______ form first.
items.vi: Để xin làm thêm ở quán cà phê, trước tiên bạn phải điền vào đơn xin việc.
items.explanation: The form you complete to ask for a job is an application form; an appointment is a fixed meeting time, an advertisement announces the job, and an interview comes after you apply.

items.q: Nam wants to be a pilot, so he is ______ a lot of effort into his English lessons.
items.vi: Nam muốn trở thành phi công nên cậu ấy đang dồn rất nhiều công sức vào các tiết tiếng Anh.
items.explanation: The collocation is put effort into something; make an effort exists but is not followed by into, and take/give effort are not English.

items.q: Lan: Can you come out and play? / Nam: Sorry, I haven't ______ my homework yet.
items.vi: Lan: Cậu ra ngoài chơi được không? / Nam: Xin lỗi, tớ chưa làm xong bài tập về nhà.
items.explanation: The verb that goes with homework is do: do your homework. Make is used for creating things (make a cake, make a decision), never for homework.

items.q: My uncle ______ as a chef in a hotel in Da Nang since 2019.
items.vi: Chú tôi đã làm đầu bếp ở một khách sạn tại Đà Nẵng từ năm 2019.
items.explanation: Since + a starting point describes an action that began in the past and continues now, which takes the present perfect: has worked.
